in_marathi.name: Medini
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Mind
in_marathi.long_meaning: Medini हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Medini is a Sanskrit name derived from the term ‘Meditate’. It is the name of a celestial nymph, the goddess of meditation and self-contemplation. This name is believed to bring inner peace, mental clarity, and focus. It also symbolizes wisdom and knowledge acquired through deep meditation.
